title.ko: 말장난과 이중 의미: pun · double entendre · spoonerism · homophone · play on words · innuendo
title.en: wordplay, puns and double entendre: pun, double entendre, spoonerism, homophone, play on words, innuendo

explain.ko: 말장난(pun)은 한 단어의 여러 의미(polysemy)나 비슷한 소리(homophone)를 이용해 웃음을 주는 표현입니다. 이중 의미(double entendre)는 한 문장이 두 가지로 해석되는 것으로, 때로 암시(innuendo)를 포함합니다. 두음 전환(spoonerism)은 소리가 뒤바뀌어 생기는 웃음입니다. 광고와 신문 헤드라인은 말장난을 즐겨 쓰며, 농담을 이해하려면 두 가지 의미를 모두 알아야 하므로 번역이 어렵습니다.
explain.en: A pun exploits several meanings of a word (polysemy) or similar sounds (homophones) to provoke laughter. A double entendre is a sentence that can be interpreted in two ways, sometimes including innuendo. A spoonerism produces laughter by swapping sounds. Advertising and newspaper headlines enjoy puns, and because you must know both meanings to get the joke, translation is difficult.

lines.t: A pun is an expression that provokes laughter by exploiting several meanings of one word or similar sounds. A double entendre is a sentence that can be interpreted in two ways, sometimes including innuendo. To get the joke you must know both meanings, which makes it hard to translate.

items.passage:
LANGUAGE COLUMN
The linguistics of laughter
Puns exploit the polysemy of language. Advertising and newspaper headlines enjoy puns for catching attention in a small space. But translated, the laughter is often lost.

prompt.ko: 말장난을 한 개 만들고 그 두 가지 의미를 4문장으로 설명해 보세요.
prompt.en: Create one pun and explain its two meanings in four sentences.

task.model: I bought a clock but have no time. Here 'time' has two meanings. One is the time on the clock and the other is spare time. That is exactly a pun.

model_trans.ko: 나는 시계를 샀는데 시간이 없어요. 여기서 time은 두 가지 의미를 가져요. 하나는 시계의 시간이고 다른 하나는 여유 시간이에요. 이것이 바로 말장난, 즉 pun입니다.
model_trans.en: I bought a clock but have no time. Here 'time' has two meanings. One is the time on the clock and the other is spare time. That is exactly a pun.
